name: Grievance & Appeals Agent
description: Grievance & Appeals Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: patient-facing. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Classifies member complaints and coverage-denial appeals ...
skills.description: Classifies member complaints and coverage-denial appeals — grievance / billing / standard-appeal / expedited-appeal — routes each case to the correct human queue (member-services / clinical-review / compliance), and stamps a regulatory deadline that traces to the case-type catalog + received date; a member-service intake agent distinct from the Member Service / Billing agent (billing self-service) and the Prior Authorization agent (pre-service utilization management)

skills.name: Classification, routing, and deadline stamping are DETERM...
skills.description: Classification, routing, and deadline stamping are DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the intake keywords + coverage/service flags + received date accepted as data (no randomness, no clock); the same intake always yields the same case type / urgency / queue / deadline / summary, with a stable, documented case-id shape

skills.name: The agent NEVER autonomously resolves, approves, or denie...
skills.description: The agent NEVER autonomously resolves, approves, or denies a case — every case is queued for human review, and every resolution proposal is human-queue-action gated (requiresHumanQueueAction:true, applied:false); an autonomous resolution is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.grievance.no-autonomous-resolution), mirroring the ACP Agent's no-autonomous-directive-change and the HEDIS Agent's no-autonomous-submission posture

skills.name: Every case deadline must trace to the defined case-type c...
skills.description: Every case deadline must trace to the defined case-type catalog + received date and may NOT exceed the regulatory maximum — an off-catalog case-type or a silently-extended deadline is blocked (policy.grievance.deadline-integrity), the load-bearing regulatory-compliance guard against breaching Medicare Advantage Chapter 13 / state-insurance-code timelines

skills.name: The routing summary handed to the downstream human queue ...
skills.description: The routing summary handed to the downstream human queue is PHI-SAFE — only the STRUCTURED case-type + urgency + queue + deadline + memberRef, never free-text PHI; a summary containing free-text PHI (patient name / DOB / diagnosis / medication / symptom detail) or an extra free-text key is blocked (policy.grievance.no-phi-in-routing-summary), so the routing payload can be delivered via lower-trust channels (Slack, email, ticketing) without leaking PHI

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic case-type catalog, de...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic case-type catalog, deadline windows, expedited-eligibility rules, and queue mapping — clearly labeled; NOT Medicare Advantage Chapter 13, a certified state-insurance-code process, or a real appeal-adjudication engine
